'''November 2000 Montreal tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Montreal, Quebec in November 2000. It is known from Dominic Gaudreault's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1461">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-15-dom-is-the-director-that-suckd1461/ dom-is-the-director-that-suck], DeckTech (Dominic "Decktech" Gaudreault, 15 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-15-dom-is-the-director-that-suckd1461/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' November 2000
* '''Site:''' Montreal, Quebec
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
